claims.head: Carlsson gets company tonight
claims.call: The Flyers’ L2 (Dvorak, Foerster and Barkey) spends at least 36% of its 5-on-5 time against the Ducks’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Flyers keep sending Dvorak’s line (Dvorak, Foerster and Barkey) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Rick Tocchet has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Ducks’ first line is Killorn, Carlsson and Klepov.
claims.nums: At home: 36% of this group’s 5-on-5 time against first lines, about 25% with no line matching
claims.gist: At home, Rick Tocchet likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Ducks’ first line.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 7 games cover only 31% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 6th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 45%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Troy Terry is on long-term injured reserve and has not played this season. He is one of their most valuable skaters.
Mikael Granlund is day to day (upper-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.

Cam York is out (upper-body injury) and has missed the last 4 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Nick Seeler has taken his spot beside Jamie Drysdale.

David Jiříček has started playing on the power play: on the ice for 44% of the team’s power-play time in 7 games, up from 2% last season.

PHI.head: The Flyers start a half-step behind
PHI.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, and the Ducks will be without Terry. The Flyers can tip it if they keep dangerous shots away.

ANA.head: The Ducks start a half-step ahead
ANA.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, but Philadelphia has home-ice advantage, and the Ducks will be without Terry. The Flyers can still swing it if they keep dangerous shots away.

story.head: The Flyers need a win

items.text: The Ducks are newly without Mikael Granlund, and have had to make do without Troy Terry all season.
The Flyers are newly without Owen Tippett, and have been without Cam York and Travis Konecny for several games.
Leo Carlsson has four goals in six games against Philadelphia since 2023-24.
Trevor Zegras faces his old team, Anaheim.
